ValidationRule.description: When opportunities are marked Closed Won, the following fields are required: Contract Start Date Contract End Date PO Number (if PO Needed)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Won"), RecordType.Name = "Sales" , OR( Contract_Attached__c = FALSE, ISBLANK( Contract_Start_Date__c ), ISBLANK( Contract_End_Date__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields are required to mark this won: Contract Start Date Contract End Date Also, a Contract must be attached to the opportunity.
